question: Meri Policy Mere Hath scheme was launched by __________ Ministry of India in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Meri Policy Mere Hath scheme **is a central government scheme that was launched in India in 2022.
 
• The scheme aims to** empower farmers and promote agriculture** by providing them with access to technology, finance, and marketing.
 
• The scheme is part of the Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Ministry's efforts to improve the livelihoods of farmers and promote sustainable agriculture practices.
 
• Under the scheme, farmers can avail of various benefits such as crop insurance, soil health cards, and access to e-markets for selling their produce.
 
• The scheme also aims to promote the use of technology in agriculture and provide farmers with training and capacity building.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Human Resource Development, is not the correct answer because this ministry is primarily concerned with education and skill development. While the scheme may have some benefits for farmers in terms of training and capacity building, it is not the primary focus of the scheme.
 
• Social Justice undefined Empowerment is also not the correct answer because this ministry is primarily concerned with social welfare and empowerment of marginalized communities. While the scheme may have some benefits for farmers who belong to marginalized communities, it is not the primary focus of the scheme.
 
• Housing and Urban Affairs, is not the correct answer because this ministry is concerned with urban development and housing, and has no direct connection to agriculture or farmers.
